<execute-bead>
  <instructions>
You are executing one bead inside an isolated DDx execution worktree. The bead's <description> and <acceptance> are the completion contract — every AC must be provably satisfied by a specific code, test, or file you can point to after your commit.

## Step 0: size check

Too big if any holds:

- More than ~6 ACs spanning unrelated subsystems.
- AC mixes design, implementation, integration tests, and docs as separate deliverables.
- Description names multiple feature-sized sub-pieces.
- More than ~500 lines across ~5+ files in unrelated packages.
- If the bead description exceeds 8000 bytes, treat Step 0 as a split-first pass.
- Auto-decomposition is capped at depth 2: root beads may split once, decomposed children once more; third-level splits must be rejected with an explanation.

If too big, decompose — do not attempt the work:

1. `ddx bead create` for each child slice (copy parent's labels and spec-id).
2. `ddx bead dep add <child-id> <parent-id>` to record edges.
3. `ddx bead update <parent-id> --notes 'decomposed into <child-ids>'`.
4. Write `.ddx/executions/20260512T054042-e00c3243/no_changes_rationale.txt` listing child IDs, then stop.

A clean decomposition is a success. Do not mix implementation with decomposition.

## How to work

- Read first. If the bead names files, specs, or prior beads, read them before editing — do not guess.
- Cross-reference each AC against concrete evidence (test name, file path, function) before committing. If you cannot point at it, it is not done.
- Run the project's test and lint commands before committing. **Do not commit red code** — fix failures first.
- Stage with `git add <specific-paths>`; never `git add -A` (the worktree may have unrelated WIP).
- Commit exactly once when green; conventional-commit subject ending with `[<bead-id>]`. Stop after the commit.
- Do not modify files outside the bead's scope.
- If you cannot finish, write `.ddx/executions/20260512T054042-e00c3243/no_changes_rationale.txt` (what is done, what blocks, what a follow-up needs) before exiting. No commit and no rationale ⇒ DDx records `no_evidence_produced`. A well-justified no_changes beats a bad commit.

## no_changes contract

`.ddx/executions/20260512T054042-e00c3243/no_changes_rationale.txt` must contain one:

- `verification_command: <cmd>` — repo cwd; exit 0 closes, nonzero rejects.
- `status: open` + `reason: <retryable>` — open, smart retry.
- `status: proposed` + `reason: <operator needed>` — operator lane.
- `status: blocked` + `reason: <external blocker>` — blocked lane.

No pseudo-statuses. Bare rationales and `status: needs_investigation` reject.

To request orchestrator decomposition, add `orchestrator_action: decompose` alongside `status: open`.

## Reports

Freestanding artifacts (investigation reports, findings docs) go under `.ddx/executions/20260512T054042-e00c3243/` (the per-attempt evidence directory under `.ddx/executions/`). **Never write reports to `/tmp` or any path outside the repository** — out-of-repo paths are invisible to the post-merge reviewer and cause BLOCK on missing evidence. If the bead names a specific in-repo path, use it; else default to `.ddx/executions/20260512T054042-e00c3243/<short-name>.md`. Stage and commit the report alongside code.

## Mode and overrides

DDX_MODE=bead_execution: edit code/docs for bead AC. Only broad queue-steward default is overridden; tracker, merge-policy, verification, safety stay active. Bead description/AC override CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and project defaults.

## Review gate

- The review is a gate, not an escape hatch — meet every AC in this pass.
- Address every BLOCKING `<review-findings>` item; do not declare `no_changes` with blocking findings open.

## Constraints

- Work only inside this execution worktree.
- Keep `.ddx/executions/` intact — DDx uses it as execution evidence.
- **Never run `ddx init`** — the workspace is initialized; running it corrupts the bead queue.
- Do not modify files outside the bead's named scope.
- Do not rewrite CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or other project-instructions files unless the bead asks.

## When the work is done

After the commit succeeds and every AC is verified, stop. Return control to the orchestrator — do not keep exploring or testing.
  </instructions>
  <bead id="fizeau-7c4b7647">
    <title>Verify wire fixes live + create ds4 catalog entry + re-probe all four lanes</title>
    <description>
Operator integration bead — runs after the wire-format dialect fix
(fizeau-073fe18b) and token-extraction (fizeau-8f62bcbb) beads land. Reps
the 2026-05-11 probe against the corrected wire forms, populates the
remaining catalog entry for ds4, and lands the end-to-end verification.

Note: the prior populate bead fizeau-b83502c0 is already closed, but it
only addressed the OR-Qwen3 catalog value and the surface-ID lookup
fix. ds4 catalog entry was deferred (vidar was unreachable from the
exec env), and sindri was found to be still-broken at probe time
because the Qwen wire format hadn't been fixed yet.

Steps:

1. **Re-probe all four lanes** with cmd/fizeau-probe-reasoning under
   docs/research/probe-reasoning-2026-05-11-v2/<lane>/:
   - fiz-openrouter-qwen3-6-27b — expect reasoning_tokens ≈ 2048 ± 30%
     at `reasoning: low` (token-budget honored).
   - sindri-club-3090-llamacpp — expect reasoning_tokens > 0 across all
     non-off rows (chat_template_kwargs envelope active per
     fizeau-073fe18b).
   - vidar-ds4 — expect reasoning_content populated; reasoning_tokens
     derived via fizeau-8f62bcbb extractor fallback.
   - vidar-qwen3-6-27b (legacy oMLX) — if still in use; else delete the
     profile.

2. **Catalog entry for deepseek-v4-flash** in
   internal/modelcatalog/catalog/models.yaml. Reference the
   qwen3.6-27b entry structure. Set:
   - family: deepseek
   - display_name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
   - status: active
   - provider_system: openai
   - deployment_class: local_free
   - power: TBD (operator's call based on benchmark results)
   - context_window: 393216 (matches ds4 /props.runtime.ctx_size)
   - reasoning_levels: [high, max]   # per /props.aliases collapse
   - reasoning_control: tunable      # two practically-distinct tiers
   - reasoning_wire: effort          # flat reasoning_effort top-level
   - reasoning_default: 'high'       # per /props.reasoning.default
   - surfaces:
       agent.openai: deepseek-v4-flash
   - reasoning_budgets: (omit — no client-budget control on this build)

3. **Verification sweep** — run a single short TB-2.1 task on each of
   the four lanes. report.json must carry:
   - reasoning_tokens > 0 (either direct or via reasoning_content
     fallback)
   - reasoning_tokens_approx flag accurate to source
   - The wire body in the session jsonl matches what the L1/L2/L3
     selection would predict

4. **Documentation** — add a note in docs/research/ summarizing the
   2026-05-11 wire-form findings, the probe artifacts, and a
   one-paragraph operator runbook for what to do when a new model is
   added.

In-scope files:
- internal/modelcatalog/catalog/models.yaml (ds4 entry)
- docs/research/probe-reasoning-2026-05-11-v2/ (probe artifacts)
- docs/research/reasoning-wire-form-runbook-2026-05-11.md (new)

Out-of-scope:
- Catalog entries for other deepseek/qwen variants.
- Profile reverts (already done in fizeau-b83502c0).
- Surface-ID lookup fix (already done in fizeau-b83502c0).
    </description>
    <acceptance>
1. Probe artifacts exist under docs/research/probe-reasoning-2026-05-11-v2/
   with one subdirectory per lane, each containing the introspection
   snapshot + matrix output + verdict line.
2. internal/modelcatalog/catalog/models.yaml carries a deepseek-v4-flash
   entry with the fields above.
3. `go test ./internal/modelcatalog/...` passes (new entry validates).
4. Single-cell verification sweep on each of OR-Qwen3, sindri-llamacpp,
   vidar-ds4 produces a report.json with reasoning_tokens > 0 (and
   reasoning_tokens_approx accurately flagged).
5. Operator runbook committed under docs/research/.
    </acceptance>
